exercises.instructionEn: Read the story. Episode 2: The Rescue.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-EPIZODNI ESLANG (110-bet):
Sandra, David va Tony Grenlandiya
ustida samolyotda uchayotganda
dvigatel to'xtadi. Tony muz ustiga
qo'nmoqchi.


2-EPIZOD TARJIMASI:

1) David: Hech bo'lmasa xavfsiz
   qo'ndik. Ishonchim komil, kimdir
   kelib bizni qutqaradi.
   Tony: Mayday! Mayday! ... Foydasi
   yo'q - radio ishlamayapti.
   Sandra: Ha, lekin dvigateldan
   ko'p tutun chiqyapti! Bu yerdan
   tezroq chiqqanimiz ma'qul!

2) Sandra: Brr! Bu yerda muzday
   sovuq!
   Tony: Isinish yo'lini topishimiz
   kerak! Narsalarimizdan chodir
   yasashga harakat qilaylik ...

3) GRRR!!!
   Sandra: Voy, yo'q! Ulkan oq ayiq!
   Tez! Kimdir yordam bering!

4) BANG!
   Sandra: Bu qanday shovqin? Voy,
   xudoga shukur! Oq ayiq qochib
   ketyapti!

5) Sandra: Rahmat! Buni qanday
   qildingiz?
   Sayyoh: Bizda maxsus 'shovqin
   chiqargichlar' bor ...

6) Andy: O'zimni tanishtiray. Men
   Andy Wilson, bu esa Ken Chapman.
   Biz sayyohlarmiz. Hammangiz
   yaxshimisiz?
   David: Ha, lekin radiomiz
   ishlamayapti. Bizni qanday
   topdingiz?
   Andy: Tutunni ko'rdik va bu nima
   ekanini ko'rgani keldik.

7-8) Andy: Biz tadqiqot stansiyasiga
   ketyapmiz. Muzlab o'lishdan oldin
   tezroq qor mototsikllarimizga
   o'tiring!
   Sandra: Sizga qanday yetarli
   rahmat aytamiz? Hayotimizni
   saqlab qoldingiz! Endi bizda
   UChTA hikoya bor - muzliklar,
   avariyali qo'nish va dahshatli oq
   ayiqdan qutulish!


⚠ 'A RESCUE':

  = qutqaruv.
  ⚠ 'to rescue' = qutqarmoq.


⚠ 'AT LEAST':

  = hech bo'lmasa.


⚠ "IT'S NO USE":

  = foydasi yo'q.


⚠ 'SMOKE':

  = tutun.


⚠ 'TO KEEP WARM':

  = isinib turmoq.


⚠ 'A TENT':

  = chodir.


⚠ 'THANK GOODNESS!':

  = Xudoga shukur!


⚠ 'TO RUN AWAY':

  = qochib ketmoq.


⚠ 'A NOISEMAKER':

  = shovqin chiqargich (hayvonlarni
  qo'rqitish uchun).


⚠ 'LET ME INTRODUCE MYSELF':

  = O'zimni tanishtiray.


⚠ 'AN EXPLORER':

  = sayyoh, kashfiyotchi.


⚠ 'TO HOP ONTO':

  = sakrab minmoq.


⚠ 'A SNOWMOBILE':

  = qor mototsikli.


⚠ 'TO FREEZE TO DEATH':

  = muzlab o'lmoq.


⚠ 'HOW CAN WE EVER THANK YOU
ENOUGH?':

  = Sizga qanday yetarli rahmat
  aytamiz? (katta minnatdorlik)


⚠ 'A CRASH LANDING':

  = avariyali qo'nish.


⚠ 'TERRIFYING':

  = dahshatli.

tasks.en: Read the story. Episode 2: The Rescue.

David: Well, at least we've landed safely. I'm sure someone will come and rescue us. Tony: Mayday! Mayday! ... It's no use - the radio isn't working. Sandra: Yes, but there's a lot of smoke coming out of the engine! We'd better get out of here quickly!
tasks.uz: David: Hech bo'lmasa xavfsiz qo'ndik. Ishonchim komil, kimdir kelib bizni qutqaradi. Tony: Mayday! Mayday! ... Foydasi yo'q - radio ishlamayapti. Sandra: Ha, lekin dvigateldan ko'p tutun chiqyapti! Bu yerdan tezroq chiqqanimiz ma'qul!

tasks.en: Sandra: Brr! It's freezing cold out here! Tony: We have to find a way to keep warm! Let's try to make a tent with some of our things ...
tasks.uz: Sandra: Brr! Bu yerda muzday sovuq! Tony: Isinish yo'lini topishimiz kerak! Narsalarimizdan chodir yasashga harakat qilaylik ...

tasks.en: GRRR!!! Sandra: Oh, no! A huge polar bear! Quick! Someone help me!
tasks.uz: GRRR!!! Sandra: Voy, yo'q! Ulkan oq ayiq! Tez! Kimdir yordam bering!

tasks.en: BANG! Sandra: What's that noise? Oh, thank goodness! The polar bear is running away!
tasks.uz: BANG! Sandra: Bu qanday shovqin? Voy, xudoga shukur! Oq ayiq qochib ketyapti!

tasks.en: Sandra: Thank you! How did you do that? Explorer: We've got special 'noisemakers' ...
tasks.uz: Sandra: Rahmat! Buni qanday qildingiz? Sayyoh: Bizda maxsus 'shovqin chiqargichlar' bor ...

tasks.en: Andy: Let me introduce myself. I'm Andy Wilson, and this is Ken Chapman. We're explorers. Are you all okay? David: Yes, but our radio isn't working. How did you find us? Andy: We saw the smoke, and we came to see what it was.
tasks.uz: Andy: O'zimni tanishtiray. Men Andy Wilson, bu esa Ken Chapman. Biz sayyohlarmiz. Hammangiz yaxshimisiz? David: Ha, lekin radiomiz ishlamayapti. Bizni qanday topdingiz? Andy: Tutunni ko'rdik va bu nima ekanini ko'rgani keldik.

tasks.en: Andy: We're on our way to the research station. Hop onto our snowmobiles quickly, before you freeze to death! Sandra: How can we ever thank you enough? You've saved our lives! And now we've got three stories to tell - the glaciers, the crash landing and an escape from a terrifying polar bear!
tasks.uz: Andy: Biz tadqiqot stansiyasiga ketyapmiz. Muzlab o'lishdan oldin tezroq qor mototsikllarimizga o'tiring! Sandra: Sizga qanday yetarli rahmat aytamiz? Hayotimizni saqlab qoldingiz! Endi bizda uchta hikoya bor - muzliklar, avariyali qo'nish va dahshatli oq ayiqdan qutulish!

exercises.instructionEn: Read the list of events from both episodes of the story and put them in the correct order, then retell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyaning ikkala epizodidagi voqealar ro'yxatini o'qing va ularni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying, keyin hikoyani qayta aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1 Sandra and David meet Tony.
  2 They take off in the plane.
  3 The plane's engine stops.
  4 They land on the ice.
  5 They get out of the plane.
  6 They start making a tent.
  7 A polar bear comes close.
  8 Two explorers scare the bear
    away.
  9 They hop onto the snowmobiles.
  10 They leave with the explorers.


⚠ 'TO TAKE OFF':

  = uchmoq (samolyot ko'tarilishi).
  ⚠ 'to land' = qo'nmoq.


⚠ 'TO COME CLOSE':

  = yaqinlashmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

Grenlandiya - inuit tilida
Kallaalit Nunaat deb ataladi -
dunyodagi eng katta orol va
Shimoliy qutbga eng yaqin quruqlik.
Uning ko'p qismi Shimoliy qutb
doirasi ustida, u yerda yozda quyosh
umuman botmaydi.

Grenlandiya 982 yilda Islandiyalik
viking Qizil Erik tomonidan
kashf qilingan. U boshqa odamlar u
yerga borishni xohlashi uchun uni
"Grenlandiya" (Yashil yurt) deb
atagan.

Grenlandiya juda sovuq iqlimga ega
- kuchli qor bo'ronlari va qishki
harorat minus 35°C gacha. Hatto
yozda ham shimolda harorat faqat
3-4°C ga yetadi.

Grenlandiyada deyarli daraxt yoki o't
yo'q, u yerda juda kam hayvon
turlarini topish mumkin, lekin orol
atrofidagi dengizlarda tyulen va
kitlar ko'p.

Ulkan muz qatlami orolning deyarli
85% ini qoplaydi. Ba'zi joylarda muz
qatlami 3 km dan qalin. Eriyotgan
muz muz qatlami chekkalarida
muzliklar hosil qiladi. Biroq,
so'nggi yillarda olimlar muzliklar
kutilganidan ancha tez erimoqda
degan xulosaga kelishdi. Agar erish
shunchalik tez davom etsa, bu dunyo
okeanlari sathining ko'tarilishiga
va global ekologik falokatga sabab
bo'lishi mumkin.


JAVOBLAR:
  1 doesn't set (present simple,
    fakt)
  2 was discovered (MAJHUL - 'by
    Erik')
  3 called (past simple, faol)
  4 has (present simple)
  5 reaches (present simple)
  6 has (present simple)
  7 covers (present simple)
  8 have noticed (present perfect -
    'in recent years')
  9 are melting (present
    continuous - hozir)
  10 continues (1-tur shart: 'if'
    + present)


⚠ MAJHUL FAQAT 2 - 'discovered BY
Erik the Red'.


⚠ 'THE INUIT':

  = inuitlar (eskimoslar).


⚠ 'THE CLOSEST':

  = eng yaqin.


⚠ 'AD':

  = Anno Domini - milodiy.


⚠ 'A CLIMATE':

  = iqlim.


⚠ 'AS LOW AS':

  = ...gacha past.


⚠ 'A SEAL':

  = tyulen.


⚠ 'A SHEET OF ICE':

  = muz qatlami.


⚠ 'THAN EXPECTED':

  = kutilganidan.


⚠ 'THE LEVEL':

  = sath.
